item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's get started. Happy Halloween! Trick or treat! Here's your weather for Saturday, October 31. Saturday! No school and no hurry today. Here in Shanghai, the day will be foggy and misty. It will reach 22 degrees, and drop down to 12 degrees. Nice and comfortable today, not too hot and not too cold. There is almost no chance of rain today. Here's something to notice: today is almost exactly as warm as yesterday. Two days the same in a row! See how far you can see through the fog this morning. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be wet right through the day, reaching 26 degrees. Here's a question for you today: if you could bring one thing to the park, what would it be? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
